mapper.sql: workflow_id, tenant_id, actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, lifecycle_action, revocation_request_id, release_request_id, workflow_status, fence_established, revocation_call_started, revoked_family_count, revoked_jti_count, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_owner, lease_until, fencing_token, recovery_started_at, iam_recovery_confirmed_at, completed_at, response_body::TEXT AS response_body
mapper.select: SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', CAST(#{tenantId} AS TEXT), true)
SELECT id, display_name AS displayName, tenant_status AS status, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tenants WHERE id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM tenant_lifecycle_workflows WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actorIdentityId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
SELECT FROM tenant_lifecycle_workflows WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workflow_status IN ('PENDING', 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT revocation_request_id FROM tenant_lifecycle_workflows WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lifecycle_action = 'SUSPEND' AND workflow_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_lifecycle_workflows (workflow_id, tenant_id, actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, lifecycle_action, revocation_request_id, release_request_id, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{row.workflowId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.actorIdentityId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.lifecycleAction}, #{row.revocationRequestId}, #{row.releaseRequestId}, #{at}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_lifecycle_workflows SET attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{retryAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND workflow_status = 'PENDING' AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken}
UPDATE tenants SET tenant_status = #{nextStatus}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND tenant_status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE tenant_lifecycle_workflows SET workflow_status = 'COMPLETED', revoked_family_count = #{revokedFamilyCount}, revoked_jti_count = #{revokedJtiCount}, response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS JSONB), completed_at = #{at}, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{at}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND workflow_status = 'PENDING' AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_suspension_recovery_idempotency (actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, tenant_id, workflow_id, request_fingerprint, created_at) VALUES (#{actorIdentityId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{tenantId}, #{workflowId}, #{fingerprint}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_lifecycle_workflows SET workflow_status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{at}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, recovery_started_at = #{at}, iam_recovery_confirmed_at = NULL, recovery_exhausted_at = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND lifecycle_action IN ('SUSPEND', 'CLOSE') AND workflow_status = 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED'
